info.title: SEN Data
info.description: Certified, governed data on Chile's national electricity system (SEN): generation, demand, marginal cost, curtailment, battery storage and commercial settlement, resolved to one canonical identity per plant and company, served as MCP tools. Free alpha; access by individual request.

post.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the SEN Data MCP server. Tools, resources and prompts are discovered dynamically from the server at connection time; they are not modelled as separate operations here. Microsoft Copilot Studio handles MCP session and protocol negotiation; this operation is not intended to be called directly by makers.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Required by the MCP Streamable HTTP transport: the server answers 406 unless the client accepts both application/json and text/event-stream.

401.description: Unauthorized. The OAuth token is missing, invalid, or expired.

406.description: Not acceptable. The Accept header must list both application/json and text/event-stream.

500.description: Internal server error from the SEN Data MCP server.

scopes.openid: OpenID Connect identity of the signed-in user
scopes.https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo: E-mail address of the signed-in user, checked against the admitted list
scopes.offline_access: Keep the connection signed in by refreshing the access token without asking the user again
